failures.observation: The first v10-focused run raised StopIteration because a negative-path subprocess mock supplied three results for four calls, and one dashboard assertion still expected the v8 predecessor exclusion marker.
failures.mutation: tests only; both real contract validators already passed
failures.correction: Added the fourth mocked result and advanced only the current dashboard identity assertion. All four focused tests pass.

failures.observation: A PowerShell ripgrep pattern used invalid quoting while searching runtime identity markers.
failures.correction: Used literal repository inspection and focused validators.

failures.observation: The first consolidated identity probe placed a pipeline immediately after a foreach block, producing PowerShell EmptyPipeElement before any hashes were emitted.
failures.correction: Collected objects into an explicit array before formatting; the corrected probe produced all admitted identities.

failures.observation: The first high-specificity ripgrep pattern began with hyphens and omitted the explicit end-of-options separator, so ripgrep interpreted the pattern as a flag and stopped before scanning.
failures.correction: Passed an explicit -- separator before the unchanged high-specificity pattern and reran the scan.

failures.observation: The pre-stage wrapper used @{upstream}, but this branch's configured merge ref is not stored by Git as a normal remote-tracking upstream, so rev-parse returned no identity and the wrapper stopped before staging.
failures.mutation: none; local HEAD and live ls-remote both reported cfeba437d0a4f18005afae53c4d7744ac6d9d4f1
failures.correction: Compare local HEAD, the explicit refs/remotes/origin branch when present, and live ls-remote directly.

release_effect: All failures are excluded from positive evidence and retained. No v0.0.30 archive, checksum, container receipt, image, tag, or release existed during them.
